zone_name: Surface stairwell, down into Zone 0: Intake Hall
name: Cold Open: The Glowing Stairwell
read_aloud: A horn sounds across the city, and stairwells open in the pavement, each firing a beam of light into the sky. The entrances stay open for one hour. Anyone still on the surface when they close remains a Native. Walk down: you become a Crawler the moment your foot touches Floor 1, not one stair sooner.
narrator_line: A horn sounds across the city, and stairwells open in the pavement, each firing a beam of light into the sky.
layout: Street level: a stairwell has opened in the pavement with a beam of light shooting straight up out of it, and concrete steps lead down into the light. At the bottom is the Intake Hall, a long hallway of identical booths.

exits.name: Down the stairs onto Floor 1; the first step onto the floor makes a Crawler (canon M-547).
Back up to the surface, until the one-hour window closes (canon M-539).
The booth doors open onto the Atrium (Z1) once intake is done.

features.name: The one-hour entrance window: the System counts it down (canon M-539, M-545).
Standing on the stairs is not entering (canon M-547).
A stairwell can open under a bystander and swallow them (canon M-548).

quick_run.setup: Stairwells with light beams open in the pavement; the one-hour entrance window is running and the characters stand at the top.
quick_run.decision: Go down now, or linger on the surface while the window runs?
quick_run.on_success: Everyone steps onto Floor 1, becomes a Crawler and finishes intake in the booths.
quick_run.on_failure: Someone lingers; the System counts down and the window closes on anyone still up top.
quick_run.cut_short: Read the System intro, have everyone step down together, and run intake from the booths.

loot.text: Nothing to loot on the stairs. Start the audience-nickname plant: the hallway screen misspells one Crawler's name (00-overview.md section 8.5).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
